newsitem.title: FINLAND: CULTOR TO SELL FISH FEED BUSINESS.
newsitem.headline: CULTOR TO SELL FISH FEED BUSINESS.

text.p: Finnish food, feed and bakery group Cultor Oy said in a statement on Monday it had agreed to sell its Ewos fish feed business activities in Denmark and Sweden to Danish company Aller Molle A/S.
"The effect of the deal on Cultor's result is neutral," Cultor said.
Cultor did not give the price of the deal.
The transaction includes Ewos' fish feed businesses in Denmark and Sweden as well as its fish feed plant in Fredericia, Denmark, it said.
Cultor said its Ewos unit will concentrate on major salmon farming countries.

"The world-wide yearly production volume of farmed salmon is approximately 500,000 tonnes, out of which Denmark and Sweden together represent approximately one percent. Leading salmon farming countries are Norway, Chile, Canada and the United Kingdom," it said.
The business activities and personnel of Ewos Aqua A/S will be transferred to family-owned Aller Molle on December 2, 1996, Cultor said.
Ewos Aqua A/S's 1995 net sales were about 60 million markka.
Cultor said its Ewos Division is the second largest world-wide actor in development, production and marketing of salmon feed with 1.07 billion markka net sales in 1995, up from 918 million in 1994.
